verified_facts.text: The resort offers guests direct access to Kalapaki Beach, whose calm waters are protected by a cove and suit swimming and light water sports.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of our AAA 4 Diamond Kauai resort enjoy direct access to Kalapaki Beach, its calm waters protected by a cove, ideal for swimming and light water sports.

verified_facts.text: The resort has the largest one-level pool in Hawaii.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make a splash and soak up the sun at the largest one-level pool in Hawaii.

verified_facts.text: All resort guests can use the complimentary Lihue Airport shuttle around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a stress-free arrival and departure with our complimentary shuttle service between The Royal Sonesta Kaua'i Resort Lihue and Lihue Airport (LIH)

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have balconies or verandas with views of the ocean, gardens or pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The guest rooms at The Royal Sonesta Kaua’i Resort Lihue feature balconies or verandas offering views of the ocean, gardens or the pool.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature refined decor, custom hardwood finishes and fine furnishings.

verified_facts.text: The Alexander Day Spa and Salon offers beachside spa treatments, including beach massages, facials and body treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pamper yourself with our beachside spa treatments. Our spa offers a range of services designed for complete relaxation, including beach massages, spa massages, facials, body treatments, and more.

verified_facts.text: The resort hosts a weekly oceanfront luau, Drums & Dances of Polynesia, on Kalapaki Bay with a backdrop of mountains and ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the spirit of Polynesia at our Drums & Dances of Polynesia luau, set against a breathtaking backdrop of mountains and ocean on Kalapaki Bay.

verified_facts.text: The resort fee includes Hawaiian cultural activities such as lei making, ukulele and hula lessons.

verified_facts.text: Guests can lounge on cabanas or daybeds on the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: But, if you prefer to simply relax, you can lounge in luxury on one of our comfortable cabanas or daybeds, basking in the sun and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Course at Hokuala, less than a mile from the resort, has the longest oceanfront golf stretch in Hawaii.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ocean Course at Hokuala, located less than a mile from our Kauai resort, boasts the longest oceanfront golf stretch in Hawaii.

verified_facts.text: Café Portofino serves Northern Italian cuisine with ocean views and was founded in 1989.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in the taste of authentic Northern Italian cuisine. Founded in 1989 by a pioneering Italian restaurateur, our elegant restaurant offers a dining experience unlike any other with breathtaking ocean views and expertly crafted dishes.

verified_facts.text: Duke's Kauai has a laid-back barefoot bar serving tropical cocktails and classic island dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit our barefoot bar for a laid-back, tropical experience and indulge in refreshing tropical cocktails and classic island dishes.

verified_facts.text: Room rates are subject to a daily resort fee plus taxes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms are charged a daily Resort Fee of $45, plus applicable taxes.

verified_facts.text: Parking is not included in the room rate.
verified_facts.excerpt: The parking fees are not included in the room rate.

verified_facts.text: As Kaua'i recovers from Hurricane Lowell, access to some beaches, attractions and excursions may be limited.
verified_facts.excerpt: As Kauaʻi continues its recovery following Hurricane Lowell, access to some beaches, attractions and excursions may be limited.

verified_facts.text: Guests must be 21 or over to check in.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that guests must be 21 years or over to check in.

verified_facts.text: Wailua Falls is easily accessible, unlike other Kauai waterfalls that require a challenging hike.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unlike other Kauai waterfalls requiring a challenging hike, Wailua Falls is easily accessible, allowing you to enjoy its charm up close.
